zh.text: 北京大学是位于北京市海淀区的公立综合性大学，隶属于教育部。学校创建于1898年，初名京师大学堂，后历经国立北京大学等名称变更。1952年院系调整后，北大迁入燕园，并整合了原燕京大学等校资源。2000年，北京医科大学并入成为医学部。目前学校设有理学、工学、医学等多个学部，涵盖多学科领域。

en.text: Peking University is a public comprehensive university located in Haidian, Beijing, China. Founded in 1898 as the Imperial University of Peking, it was renamed Peking University in 1912. In 1952, the university merged with Yenching University and moved to its current campus in Yan Garden. The Beijing Medical University joined the institution in 2000, forming the Health Science faculty. The university comprises eight faculties covering sciences, engineering, humanities, and medicine.
